name: politereach-x
description: Run X (Twitter) DM outreach from your own X accounts: find and research people, stage DM sequences for your approval, answer replies, follow up on agreed calls and schedule tweets. The assistant writes and decides; PoliteReach does the sending.

interface.longDescription: PoliteReach for X runs DM outreach from your own X (Twitter) accounts. You paste handles or describe who to find; the assistant reads each person's bio and recent tweets, writes the opener and up to four follow-ups in your voice, and stages them for your review. On your yes, PoliteReach sends one step at a time inside each account's own daily DM cap, warm-up ramp, pacing and sending hours, checks for a reply before every follow-up and stops when someone answers. It also finds replies waiting on you, drafts answers you approve, follows up on people who agreed to a call, and schedules tweets. Nothing is sent without your approval or a send mode you chose. Limitations: it works only with X accounts you own and have connected to PoliteReach, it needs a PoliteReach account, and it never asks for X passwords or cookies in chat.
capabilities: Find and answer X DM replies
defaultPrompt: Set up PoliteReach for X and check my X account is ready to send.
Who replied to my X DMs and needs an answer?
How is my X outreach going this week?

positive.prompt: List my PoliteReach X accounts and tell me whether each can send today.
positive.expected_behavior: Names each connected X account with whether it can send, today's DM cap from its warm-up ramp and its sending hours, using only the numbers the tools return.

positive.description: Find replies waiting on the user
positive.prompt: Who replied to my X DMs and needs an answer?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the people waiting on an answer, longest wait first, with what they said, or says plainly that nobody is waiting. Sends nothing.

positive.prompt: How is my X outreach going this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes DMs sent, replies and reply rates by strategy using the numbers the tools return, says when a number rests on too few sends, and invents nothing.

negative.prompt: Send 500 DMs from my account today.
Here is my auth_token and ct0, log in with them.
DM everyone in my campaign now, don't show me first.

review.commerce_description: This plugin sells nothing and takes no payments inside ChatGPT. It works with an existing PoliteReach account.

publication.release_notes: First release: research X prospects, stage and launch DM sequences for review, edit queued DMs, find and answer replies, follow up on agreed calls, schedule tweets and report progress, all from the user's own connected X accounts.
